text:
maya: quick note 1: we started seeing error amplification in eu1 after yesterday's image push (model-redwood-3.2.1 + tokenizer patch). 5xxs rising on inference service. Can we fast-track a mitigation?

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Alert at 21:04 UTC: inference-service eu1 5xx rate 11% (10m window). Canary workload fraction: 8%. Recent deploy: image-redwood-2026-03-22-3.2.1. Suggested mitigation: rollback image OR pin to previous model variant. Runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/fast-rollback

henry: Any user-facing incidents yet?

maya: A handful of 504s surfaced to a few customers; SLO alert triggered. Not widespread but rising.

lia: I looked at traces: many timeouts during KV cache loads, GPU memory pressure on pod nodes. Error logs show: `inference_worker.cpp: GPU_MEM_ALLOC_FAIL`.

ops-lead: If 5xx >= 10% and we can't find a config quickfix, escalate to rollback/pin. We can do a region-specific pin to avoid global churn.

maya: Proposal: pin eu1 to model-redwood-3.1.9 (pre-patch) and keep other regions on 3.2.1. Skip canary to speed mitigation. Any objections?

oncall: +1 from oncall. We can follow with an A/B smoke suite.

henry: Note: tokenization diffs might change some customers' outputs. Should warn support and CS.

releasebot: Preparing draft note: "Emergency: Pin eu1 to model-redwood-3.1.9 due to elevated 5xxs after 3.2.1 rollout. Regional mitigation in effect; investigating root cause. Postmortem to follow." Draft link: https://go/redwood/drafts/PR-5120

maya: Executing fast pin now. Command below.

maya: ```
/deploy region-pin eu1 model-redwood-3.1.9 --skip-canary --reason "elevated 5xx after 3.2.1" --ticket INC-3461
```

deploy-bot: Command acknowledged. Verifying perms and safety checks. Safety checks: capacity OK; compatibility check flagged tokenization-hint, but compatibility mode allowed. Proceed?

maya: Proceed. Confirmed by ops-lead via DM.

deploy-bot: Pin in progress -> rolling 100% in eu1 with a 30s ramp per sub-pool.

lia: Running quick smoke: sample prompt set -> compare outputs. Latency lookback: p95 returns to baseline after ~90s.
henry: Notifying support: "eu1 mitigation in place, expect minor output diffs for some tokenization cases."

deploy-bot: Pin complete at 21:06:45 UTC. Current 5xx rolling avg: 0.9% over 3m. p95 latency back to normal.

oncall: Verified synthetic checks green. Marking incident as mitigated.

ops-lead: Good. Next steps: (1) keep region pinned for 2 hours, (2) run longer regression eval, (3) collect heap/gpu dumps from failing pods, (4) decide whether to roll a patched 3.2.2 or keep 3.1.9.

maya: I'll own the telem collection and create a follow-up PR for canary gating improvements. Filing INC-3461 now.

releasebot: Release note published and customer-facing blurb queued for CS. PR: https://go/redwood/prs/5120

henry: small ask: create a support playbook snippet for tokenization diffs so CS has a quick checklist.

maya: Will do and drop link in the incident.

oncall: I'll shadow metrics for the next 60 minutes.

maya: thanks all. closing the thread for the fast path; will reopen if any regressions.
